errors.evidence: The chart displays data for five banks, not six. The description incorrectly counts them and even lists one bank twice.
The chart does not specify the currency unit for the y-axis. The description hallucinates that the unit is Bulgarian Leva (BGN).
The line for УниКредит Булбанк does not drop to 150,000. Its lowest point is around 230,000 in 2011. In 2012, its value is still around 230,000.
The markers for Банка ДСК are diamonds (ромбове), not squares (квадрати).
The line for Банка ДСК reaches its minimum of around 80,000 in 2011, not 2012. In 2012, the value has already recovered to approximately 190,000.
The line for ПИБ (grey) never drops to 0. Its lowest point is around 30,000 in 2012.
The markers for ОББ вкл. СИБ are 'x' shaped (кръстовидни), not round (кръгли). The round markers belong to ПИБ.
The line for ОББ вкл. СИБ drops to a negative value (approximately -20,000) in 2012, not to 'around 0'.
